---------*Change Teams/Infight**---
_setFoeInfight_ task:
	daily from 00:00 to 24:00
	change foe _archer_ infighting true
	change foe _warrior_ infighting true
	change foe _healer_ infighting true
	change foe _spells_ infighting true
	change foe _tiger_ infighting true
	change foe _spider_ infighting true
	change foe _assassin_ infighting true
	change foe _dragon_ infighting true
	change foe _nblade_ infighting true
	change foe _rogue_ infighting true
	change foe _orc_ infighting true
	change foe _orcs_ infighting true
	change foe _barb_ infighting true
	change foe _ally_ infighting true
	change foe _ally_ team 1
	change foe _tiger_ team 21
	change foe _assassin_ team 21
	change foe _dragon_ team 21
	change foe _spider_ team 21
	change foe _nblade_ team 21
	change foe _rogue_ team 21
	change foe _archer_ team 21
	change foe _warrior_ team 21
	change foe _healer_ team 21
	change foe _spells_ team 21
	change foe _assassin_ team 21
	change foe _nblade_ team 21
	setvar _second_
	clear _setFoeInfight_

_reinFoput1_ task:
	create foe _warrior_ every 5 minutes indefinitely with 100% success
	
_reinFoput2_ task:
	create foe _barb_ every 5 minutes indefinitely with 100% success
	
_reinFoput3_ task:
	create foe _orc_ every 5 minutes indefinitely with 100% success
	
_reinFoput4_ task:
	create foe _orcs_ every 5 minutes indefinitely with 100% success


_endquestproper_ task:
killed 8 _barb_
-legal repute -50
remove foe _barb_
say 1014
clear _reinFoput2_
Leave Ship

_endquestproper2_ task:
killed 8 _warrior_
-legal repute -50
remove foe _warrior_
say 1014
clear _reinFoput1_
Leave Ship

_endquestproper3_ task:
killed 6 _orc_
clear _reinFoput3_

_endquestproper4_ task:
killed 2 _orcs_
clear _reinFoput4_

_endquestproper5_ task:
when _endquestproper3_ and _endquestproper4
-legal repute -50
remove foe _orc_
remove foe _orcs_
say 1014
Leave Ship
